title: Fix a consistent-hash shard router
acceptanceCriteria: A key routes to the node at the first ring position **at or after** its hash, with positions compared as numbers
A key hashing past the highest position wraps around to the lowest one
With virtual nodes, each of 4 nodes owns between 15% and 35% of 10,000 keys
Removing a node moves only the keys it owned, and no key routes to it afterwards
Adding a 5th node moves keys only to the new node — between 10% and 30% of them
